# ToolGrad — verified chain-first tool-use dataset generation

Структурированная запись источника. [Карточка](../../studies/toolgrad.md) · [Первоисточник](https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.950/)

## Текущий обзор

[toolgrad-bk005-source-proxy-20261106](../../reviews/toolgrad/2026-11-06-chain-validation-ab.md) — BOUNDED_CODE_REVIEW. Actual source validate_api_response and chain_update_step run on 500 synthetic chains; proposer, selector, inverse query and ToolBench DFS replaced with deterministic local mechanisms. 500/500 both arms, no measured model benefit; 10/10 benign error_count=0 JSON erroneously refused. No SFT, BFCL, LLM calls, production changes.

## Применимость к проектам

Перенесены явные документальные оценки. Это частичный охват проектов, не проверенный integration seam и не измеренная польза.

- [dsh-paper2agent](../../projects/dsh-paper2agent.md): DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE; OFFLINE_METHOD_CANDIDATE / NO_MODEL_BENEFIT_VERIFIED. Owner project remained research candidate after source-backed synthetic ToolGrad proxy test: no LLM model improvement and no actual source-level project integration verified. Ограничения: Original source workflow updater/validator executed, but only synthetic 12-API in-memory fixture; 10 valid error_count:0 responses rejected; source integration and human-query distribution unknown; DSH security gate remains separate. Следующий тест: Verify target repo@SHA and read-only integration seam; if needed build consent-gated, held-out tool chain test with real user-like intents, independent state oracle and LLM token/cost budget; no production side effects. ## Эксперименты

- toolgrad-bk005-chain-state-oracle-20261106: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. Source-backed Pydantic workflow updater and API response validator executed on 5 seeds x 100 tasks over 12 synthetic stateful APIs; chain-first and local bounded DFS both 500/500; 100 impossible targets rejected; 500 truncated-chain oracle mutations rejected; original validator 10/10 benign error_count:0 false negatives. No Gemini / model API / ToolBench / original DFS / SFT / BFCL. Answer-first always generates reachable tasks, DFS written locally; 500/500 cannot establish comparative ToolGrad benefit; time CPU RSS not feature-equivalent. [Артефакт](../../reviews/toolgrad/2026-11-06-chain-validation-ab.md) · [Артефакт](../../experiments/2026-11-06-bk005-toolgrad-chain-validation-ab.py) · [Артефакт](../../data/results/toolgrad/2026-11-06-chain-validation-ab.json)
